instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME & FONTS: In `frontend/src/index.css`, import `@fontsource-variable/lora` and `@fontsource-variable/dm-sans`. Configure `--font-heading: 'Lora Variable', serif;` and `--font-sans: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif;`. Set `:root` paper palette (#FAF7F2 background, #1F1B16 text, #E8DEC8 border, #A65B32 primary terracotta accent).

2. TEST IDS: Every button, input, navigation link, mood stone, and tab MUST have clear data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-journal-link', data-testid='daily-prompt-textarea', data-testid='save-reflection-btn', data-testid='mood-stone-joyful', data-testid='ai-summarize-btn').

3. STATIC PREVIEW SAFETY: Never let a failed API request break the whole page. If the backend is loading or unreachable, gracefully show seeded mock reflections and default stats with skeleton states rather than an error crash.

4. AUTH IMPLEMENTATION: In `backend/server.py` and routers, provide clean email login & signup endpoints setting httpOnly cookie sessions via `lib/session.ts`. Also ship a convenient 'Quick Demo Login' button so reviewers can test immediately.

5. AI FEATURES: Use Emergent LLM integration in `backend/` (`emergentintegrations` or direct LLM assistant helper) for 3 endpoints: `/api/ai/summarize`, `/api/ai/prompt-suggestions`, and `/api/ai/stress-patterns`.
6. DATE & NUMBER FORMATTING: Render dates cleanly (e.g., '24 Aug 2026') and show friendly streak counts.
7. COMPLETE CRUD: Ensure journal entries can be created, edited, deleted, and filtered by mood or category.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic AI purple or harsh neon gradients on white paper.
Maintain generous spacing: p-6 to p-8 on cards to let reflections breathe.
Ensure all interactive buttons have clear hover and active feedback.
Use Sonner for toast notifications ('Reflection saved to your sanctuary', 'Streak updated!').
